text: Given an existing flexible asset type ID with configured fields, when get_flexible_asset_type is called, then the response includes id, name, and a fields list with one entry per configured field (each with at least id, name and kind).
Given a flexible asset type ID that does not exist, when get_flexible_asset_type is called, then the response is the not_found error envelope, not a raw HTTP error.
Given a flexible asset type with no custom fields configured, when get_flexible_asset_type is called, then the response's fields list is an empty array, not an error and not a missing key.

Given a real IT Glue tenant, when an agent fetches a type's fields with get_flexible_asset_type and then creates a flexible asset using the returned field names as trait keys, then the IT Glue UI shows the new asset with those trait values correctly attached.
steps: Call get_flexible_asset_type with a real flexible_asset_type_id and record the returned fields list
Call create_flexible_asset for that type, using the returned field names as traits keys with sample values
Open the new asset in the IT Glue web UI
Compare the UI's displayed trait values against the request sent to create_flexible_asset
expect: The IT Glue UI shows the new flexible asset with every trait set to the value sent, under the field names get_flexible_asset_type returned.
notes: Needs a real vendor account; no IT Glue test tenant is available to this pipeline. Not a blocker per references/mcp-track.md §3.
